title: Hetunā bāhira
text: 3 Rūpā bhikkhave anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rupānam uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtā bhikkhave rūpā kuto attā bhavissanti || || 4-7 Saddā || || Gandhā || || Rasā || || Phoṭṭhabbā || || 8 Dhammā anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo dhammānam uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtā bhikkhave dhammā kuto attā bhavissanti || || [page 132] 132 SAḶĀYATANA-SAṂYUTTA [XXXV. 144. 9 9 Evam passam || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || || Devadahavaggo catuttho || Tassuddānaṃ || || Devadahakhaṇo Saṅgayha || Agayha dve honti Palāsinā || Hetunā pi tayo vuttā || || Duve ajjhatta-bāhirāti || || CHAPTER V NAVAPURĀṆAVAGGO PAÑCAMO
